zh-CN.page_title: option-berth · 服务起没起来，不用再猜
zh-CN.description: oberth 是 Git worktree 的本地服务引擎。一份清单说清该跑什么，一条命令回答是不是真在跑、没跑为什么；人和 coding agent 读同一份事实。
zh-CN.hero_lede: oberth 是 Git worktree 的本地服务引擎：一份清单说清该跑什么，一条命令回答是不是真在跑、没跑为什么。人和 coding agent 读同一份事实。
zh-CN.pain_c: ，没人说得清哪个服务真的在跑
zh-CN.how_title: 你确认清单，引擎回答事实。
zh-CN.how_intro: 从确认清单到启动服务，再到读回事实，只有一条链。
zh-CN.stage_1_body: 清单由人确认，agent 只能起草；运行归属跟着起它的 worktree。
zh-CN.stage_2_body: up 先跑 prepare，再按 depends_on 启动，并等待真实就绪。
zh-CN.stage_3_body: 进程、监听和健康是分开的事实；没有端口不等于没在跑。
zh-CN.stage_4_body: logs 读服务自己的输出和退出原因，不重新拼一条系统命令。
zh-CN.commands_intro: 从状态到日志，人读表格，agent 读 --json；同一份契约，不用另记一套。
zh-CN.command_empty: 没有匹配的命令。清空输入查看全部。
zh-CN.cmd_status_desc: 现在是什么状态：声明、运行、端口和最近一次退出。
zh-CN.cmd_up_desc: 按 depends_on 顺序启动服务，并等待实际就绪。
zh-CN.cmd_logs_desc: 回到失败现场，读服务自己的输出。
zh-CN.cmd_down_desc: 只停这个 worktree 的项目服务，不动另一个 checkout。
zh-CN.cmd_workplace_desc: 把做过的命令与任务留在 worktree 上，下一轮还能接手。
zh-CN.cmd_doctor_desc: 检查环境、清单与运行条件，不把未知当成成功。
zh-CN.facts_lead_note: 不是一张整机端口表；只回答这个 worktree 声明的服务。
zh-CN.fact_process_note: worker 没有端口，也靠运行记录确认。
zh-CN.fact_port_note: auto 端口由引擎分配，跟着服务显示。
zh-CN.fact_exit_note: 失败会留下原因、退出码和日志。
zh-CN.fact_worker_note: 没有监听，不等于没在跑。
zh-CN.install_intro: 从源码构建，或下载对应平台的发布包。发布包只含引擎与 adapter。
zh-CN.install_note: 构建不会安装软件或启动日常服务。mage install 会写入安装目录并修改 PATH。
zh-CN.install_release_body: 脚本解析最新发布，按平台下载并核对 SHA256，装到 ~/.local/bin；固定版本加 --version。
zh-CN.install_release_windows: Windows 用 PowerShell：irm .../install.ps1 | iex；v1.1.1 起 amd64 也有 MSI。完整服务场景在 macOS/Linux 验证；Windows 是独立原生构建与冒烟，不等于完整的生命周期支持。
zh-CN.faq_a1: 界面是独立的 macOS 客户端，不在这个仓库，也不随引擎发布。
zh-CN.faq_q2: 会接管整台机器的端口吗？
zh-CN.faq_a2: 不会。它只回答当前 worktree 声明的服务；machine: 依赖只读，起停不碰它们。
zh-CN.faq_a3: 产品的 Git 操作只读。清单由人确认，agent 可以起草，但不能代替你采纳。
zh-CN.faq_q4: 没有端口就是没在运行吗？
zh-CN.faq_a4: 不是。无端口 worker 通过运行记录观察；进程、监听和健康是分开的事实。
zh-CN.faq_a5: 有原生构建、冒烟和部分事实/持久化检查；完整服务场景只在 macOS/Linux 验证。
zh-CN.faq_q6: 需要模型账号或云端吗？
zh-CN.faq_a6: 不需要。引擎本地运行，不内置模型推理，也没有云端同步。
zh-CN.faq_q7: 怎么让 coding agent 学会用它？
zh-CN.faq_a7: skill 是独立仓库，用 npx skills add SheathedSharp/option-berth-skill -g 装到本机已安装的 agent；Claude Code 也可走插件市场。引擎不会替你装。
zh-CN.cta_title: 给下一份代码，一个泊位。
zh-CN.cta_body: 引擎、macOS 客户端与 coding agent skill 各自发版，共用同一条事实链。

en.description: oberth is a local service engine for Git worktrees. One manifest says what should run; one command answers whether it really is, and why not. People and coding agents read the same facts.
en.hero_lede: oberth is a local service engine for Git worktrees: one manifest says what should run, one command says whether it really is running, and why not. People and coding agents read the same facts.
en.pain_c: , and no one can say which service is actually running
en.how_intro: From confirming the manifest to starting services and reading the facts back, there is one chain.
en.stage_1_body: A person confirms the manifest; an agent may only draft it. A run belongs to the worktree that started it.
en.stage_2_body: up runs prepare first, then starts services in depends_on order and waits for real readiness.
en.stage_3_body: Process, listener and health are separate facts. No port does not mean not running.
en.stage_4_body: logs reads the service's own output and exit reason, not a reassembled system command.
en.commands_intro: From status to logs, people read tables and agents read --json; the same contract, with no second set to remember.
en.command_empty: No matching command. Clear the field to see them all.
en.cmd_status_desc: What is true now: declaration, runtime, ports and the last exit.
en.cmd_up_desc: Start services in depends_on order and wait for real readiness.
en.cmd_logs_desc: Return to the failure scene and read the service's own output.
en.cmd_down_desc: Stop only this worktree's services, without touching another checkout.
en.cmd_workplace_desc: Keep the commands and tasks run here on the worktree for the next session.
en.cmd_doctor_desc: Check the environment, manifest and run conditions without calling unknown a success.
en.facts_lead_note: Not a machine-wide port list; it answers only for the services this worktree declares.
en.fact_process_note: A worker with no port is still confirmed by its run record.
en.fact_port_note: An auto port is assigned by the engine and shown with its service.
en.fact_health_note: A live process is not the same as a healthy one.
en.fact_exit_note: A failure leaves a reason, an exit code and logs.
en.fact_worker_note: No listener does not mean not running.
en.install_intro: Build from source, or download the archive for your platform. Archives contain only the engine and adapter.
en.install_note: Building installs nothing and starts no daily service. mage install writes to the install directory and changes PATH.
en.install_release_body: The script resolves the latest release, downloads the archive for this platform, verifies SHA256, and installs into ~/.local/bin; pin a version with --version.
en.install_release_windows: On Windows use PowerShell: irm .../install.ps1 | iex; amd64 also gets an MSI from v1.1.1. Full service scenarios are verified on macOS/Linux; Windows has native build and smoke checks, not full lifecycle coverage.
en.faq_q1: Does it have a graphical interface?
en.faq_a1: The interface is the separate macOS client. It is not in this repository and does not ship with the engine.
en.faq_q2: Does it take over every port on the machine?
en.faq_a2: No. It answers only for the current worktree's declared services; machine: dependencies stay read-only.
en.faq_q3: Does it write to my Git repository?
en.faq_a3: Product Git actions are read-only. A person confirms the manifest; an agent may draft it but cannot adopt it for you.
en.faq_q4: Does no port mean it is not running?
en.faq_a4: No. A portless worker is observed through its run record; process, listener and health are separate facts.
en.faq_a5: There are native builds, smoke tests and some fact/persistence checks. Full service scenarios are verified only on macOS/Linux.
en.faq_q6: Does it need a model account or the cloud?
en.faq_a6: No. The engine runs locally, contains no model inference and has no cloud sync.
en.faq_q7: How does a coding agent learn to use it?
en.faq_a7: The skill is a separate repository. Install it for the agents already on your machine with npx skills add SheathedSharp/option-berth-skill -g, or through the Claude Code plugin marketplace. The engine does not install it for you.
en.cta_title: A berth for your next checkout.
en.cta_body: The engine, the macOS client and the coding-agent skill release on their own schedules and share one chain of facts.
